faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Short answers to the things parents and students ask us most.

subjects.q: Which subjects and grade levels does Mamopedia cover?
subjects.a: Mamopedia supports core subjects taught in Iraqi primary and secondary schools, including mathematics, physics, chemistry, biology, Arabic, English, and social studies. Coverage expands continuously based on pilot feedback.

languages.q: Which languages can my child use to ask questions?
languages.a: Students can chat in Arabic, Kurdish (Sorani), or English. Mamopedia automatically detects the language of each question and responds in the same language.

free.a: Yes. During our pilot program the core experience is free. We'll announce any paid plans well in advance and always keep a free tier available for students.

privacy.q: How do you protect student privacy and data?
privacy.aBefore: We minimize what we collect and never sell student data. Conversations are used to improve learning recommendations and are protected with modern encryption. See our

ages.q: What ages is Mamopedia designed for?
ages.a: The experience is tuned for students roughly ages 10-18 and adapts its tone and difficulty based on the grade level you set. Younger children should use it with adult supervision.

offline.a: Mamopedia currently needs an internet connection to generate personalized answers and quizzes. We're exploring a lightweight offline study pack for areas with limited connectivity.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introP1: This policy explains what Mamopedia collects, why, who it is shared with, and what you can do about it. It applies to the Mamopedia mobile apps (iOS and Android) and the Mamopedia website.
privacy.introP2Mid: (registry code 17525103), Lõõtsa tn 5, Lasnamäe linnaosa, 11415 Tallinn, Estonia (“we”, “us”). We are the data controller for the personal data described here. For anything in this policy, contact

items.run: We collect what is needed to run a study tool: your account, the questions you ask, the quizzes you take, and the pages of any book you photograph.
items.noSell: We do not sell your data, we do not advertise, and we do not track you
items.ai: Your questions and the passages retrieved from a textbook are sent to an AI provider in order to produce an answer. This is the single most important thing to understand about how the app works — see section 4.
items.erase: You can erase your conversations, quizzes and books from inside the app, and you can delete your account entirely.

email.label: Email address
email.why: Identifies your account. Every record we hold about you is keyed to it.

name.label: Display name
name.why: Shown back to you in the app. Nothing else.

password.label: Password
password.why: Handled by Google Firebase Authentication. We never see or store it.

questions.label: Questions you ask, and the answers returned
questions.why: Your conversation history, so you can return to it.

photos.label: Photographs of book pages you upload
photos.why: To build a personal book you can ask questions about.

quiz.label: Quiz answers and results
quiz.why: To mark a quiz and show you how you did.

support.label: Support messages, reports and any attachments
support.why: To answer you, and to review reported content.

created.h: Created as you use the app

text.label: Text extracted from your photographed pages
text.why: The searchable form of your book.

usage.label: Usage counters (how much you have asked and generated, per day and per month)
usage.why: To enforce the allowances of your plan.

subscription.label: Subscription status and store identifiers
subscription.why: To grant and maintain what you paid for.

push.label: Push notification token
push.why: To notify you when a support reply or a long-running task completes.

timestamps.label: Timestamps of account and content activity
timestamps.why: To order your history and run the deletion process.

items.tracking: Advertising or tracking identifiers. The apps contain no advertising or third-party analytics tracking of any kind.
items.location: Your location. We never request it, and photographs you upload have the camera and location information embedded by your phone removed before they are stored (see section 7).
items.payment: Your payment card details. See section 6.
items.other: Contacts, calendar, microphone or health data.

notCollect.note: Camera and photo library access are requested only when you choose to photograph or select a page, and only for that purpose.

why.h: 3. Why we use it, and our legal basis
why.p: Where the GDPR or comparable law applies, our legal bases are:

account.purpose: Creating and running your account; answering your questions; building your books; marking your quizzes
account.basis: Performance of a contract with you

allowances.purpose: Enforcing plan allowances; preventing abuse; keeping the service secure

payments.purpose: Processing payments and keeping records of them

support.purpose: Responding to support requests and moderating reported content

push.basis: Consent, which you give at the system prompt and can withdraw in device settings

why.note: We do not use your content to train AI models, and we do not permit our providers to do so on our behalf. See section 4.

ai.p: Answering a question requires sending data to a third-party AI provider. Specifically, we send:

items.question: the question you typed;
items.passages: the passages retrieved from the textbook you selected;
items.conversation: the recent part of that conversation, so the answer follows on;
items.images: for a book you photograph, the page images themselves, so their text can be read back.

ai.providers: Our AI providers are Alibaba Cloud and Google. They process this data as our sub-processors, under contract and on our instructions, solely in order to return a result. They are not permitted to use it for their own purposes or to train their models.
ai.warning: Please do not photograph or type anything you would not want processed by a third party, including pages containing personal information about you or anyone else.

sharing.p: We share personal data only with service providers acting on our instructions:

google.role: Hosting, accounts, data and file storage, push notifications

sharing.legal: We also disclose data where we are legally required to, or where it is necessary to establish or defend legal claims, or to protect someone's safety.
sharing.noSell: We do not sell personal data, and we do not share it for cross-context behavioural advertising

payments.p1: Subscriptions are sold through the Apple App Store, Google Play, or Stripe, depending on the platform you use.
payments.p2: Your card details never reach us.
payments.p3b: Deleting your Mamopedia account does not cancel a store subscription

items.https: All traffic is encrypted with HTTPS/TLS.
items.password: Passwords are handled by Firebase Authentication and are never visible to us.
items.access: Your conversations, quizzes and books are readable only by your account. This is enforced on the server, not merely hidden in the app.
items.photos: Photographs of your pages are stored privately, keyed to your account identifier, and are not reachable by a public URL.
items.metadata: removes the metadata your phone embedded in it
items.support: Support conversations and reported content are readable only by the operator accounts that must act on them.

protect.note: No system is perfectly secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

account.label: Account, conversations, quizzes, books
account.retention: Until you erase them or delete your account

usage.label: Usage counters
usage.retention: Monthly counters for the current and recent periods; lifetime counters where a plan is a one-off allowance

support.label: Support and moderation records
support.retention: Kept after the conversation ends, so that a decision can be reviewed

payment.label: Payment and subscription records
payment.retention: As long as required by tax and accounting law

backups.label: Backups
backups.retention: Cleared on the ordinary backup rotation after deletion

rights.h: 9. Your rights and how to use them
rights.p: Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, export, restrict or object to our processing of your data, and to withdraw consent. Two of these are built into the app:
rights.eraseText: Settings → Your data lets you erase your conversations, quizzes and books — separately or together. This is immediate and irreversible.
rights.deleteText: Settings → Your data → Delete account. Your account is scheduled for deletion after a 15-day grace period, and you are signed out of every device. Signing in again during those 15 days cancels the deletion — there is nothing else to click. After that, your account and its content are permanently removed.
rights.otherBefore: For anything else — access, correction, export, or a complaint — contact
rights.otherAfter: . We will respond within the period the applicable law requires (one month under the GDPR).
rights.complaintBefore: You also have the right to complain to a supervisory authority. Ours is the Estonian Data Protection Inspectorate (Andmekaitse Inspektsioon), Tatari 39, 10134 Tallinn, Estonia —
rights.complaintAfter: . If you live in another EU or EEA country, you may complain to your local authority instead.

children.p1: Mamopedia is a study tool built for school students, so we expect many of our users to be minors.
children.p2: You must be at least 13 years old to create an account.
children.p3Before: We do not knowingly collect personal data from a child below the applicable age without the consent that the law requires. If you believe a child has provided us with personal data without that consent, contact
children.p3After: and we will delete the account and its content.
children.p4: Children have the same rights as everyone else under section 9, and a parent or guardian may exercise them on the child's behalf.

transfers.p1: We are established in Estonia, in the European Union, so the GDPR governs our processing — including for users outside the EU.
transfers.p2: Our infrastructure sits in the United States, and AI processing may take place outside the EEA as well (section 4). Your data is therefore transferred out of the European Economic Area to countries whose data protection laws differ from the EU's.
transfers.p3Before: For those transfers we rely on the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses, incorporated into our agreements with the providers named in section 5, together with any additional safeguards those agreements require. Where a provider is certified under the EU–US Data Privacy Framework, we rely on that adequacy decision instead. You may request a copy of the relevant safeguards by writing to

changes.p: We will update this page when our practices change, and revise the “Last updated” date above. If a change materially affects your rights, we will give notice in the app before it takes effect.

acceptance.p: By accessing or using Mamopedia ("the Service"), you agree to be bound by these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree, please do not use the Service.

use.p: Mamopedia is provided as an educational companion for Iraqi students. You agree to use it lawfully and respectfully. You are responsible for any content you submit and for maintaining the security of your account.

ip.p: All content, branding, and software associated with Mamopedia are the property of KeyU.Tech and are protected by applicable intellectual property laws.

disclaimer.p: Mamopedia is offered on an "as is" basis. While we strive for accuracy, AI-generated content may contain errors. Always verify important information with a qualified teacher or trusted source.

changes.p: We may update these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the Service after changes indicates acceptance of the updated Terms.

deleteAccount.title: Delete Your Account
deleteAccount.intro: You can delete your Mamopedia account at any time from inside the app. Here is how it works, step by step.

login.title: Log in to your account
login.body: Open the Mamopedia app and sign in with the account you want to delete.

settings.title: Go to the app settings
settings.body: Open the settings screen from the app menu.

tap.title: Click on “Delete account”
tap.body: Find the “Delete account” option in settings and select it.

confirm.title: Confirm the deletion
confirm.body: Confirm your choice when the app asks you to. This starts the deletion.

wait.title: Your account is deleted after 15 days
wait.body: Your account will be deleted after 15 days if you don't log in again.

note.title: Changed your mind?
note.body: Logging back in during those 15 days cancels the deletion and keeps your account active.

help.before: If you can't access the app or need help, email us at
help.middle: . To delete only your data and keep your account, see

deleteData.title: Delete Your Data
deleteData.intro: You can delete the data Mamopedia has stored for you at any time from inside the app. Here is how it works, step by step.

login.title: Log in to your account
login.body: Open the Mamopedia app and sign in with the account whose data you want to delete.

settings.title: Go to the app settings
settings.body: Open the settings screen from the app menu.

tap.title: Click on “Delete data”
tap.body: Find the “Delete data” option in settings and select it.

confirm.title: Confirm the deletion
confirm.body: Confirm your choice when the app asks you to. This starts the deletion.

notify.title: We notify you when it's done
notify.body: The deletion process starts in the background and you will be notified once it is done.

note.title: Your account stays active
note.body: Deleting your data clears what Mamopedia has stored for you - you can keep using the app and start fresh.
